note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs records with bill-of-lading numbers, destination countries and HS codes — 5 concrete rows seen out of a claimed 790, latest 2026-02-25, destinations Zimbabwe, Fiji, Mauritius, France (plus counterparty aggregates pointing to DR Congo and Benin). HS code on all observed rows is 30049099 (finished medicaments, retail packs), NOT the declared 300450 (which covers vitamin preparations in dosage) — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: the company stays in the base and the actual code should be corrected to 30049099, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Role: manufacturer-exporter of own branded formulations (batch numbers, own manufacturing dates, own label names such as BIGZOLE, SITABET, COLOPREP, TRE-BON), so manufacturer_trader/manufacturer rather than pure trader. Revenue and export volume in value terms: null — ImportKey free view gives shipment counts only, no values; not invented. Domestic supply: no traces found in accessible public sources, but this is a data-access limitation (registry pages blocked), not evidence of absence — recorded as unknown rather than none_found.
